---
title: Add careers and tracks that are still missing
labels: content
---

**Careers.** Security awareness specialist, third-party risk analyst, security product manager.

**Tracks.** Vulnerability management, mobile security.

**Method.** Follow the layout of the existing profiles and tracks. Write in your own words, and include interview questions and training resources. Update `careers/README.md`, `tracks/README.md`, `roadmap/03-pick-a-track.md` and the `CONTRIBUTING.md` wishlist.

**Done when.** Each new page passes `python3 scripts/check_links.py`, `check_style.py` and `check_review_dates.py`.
